stem: Task on-time completion improves from 88% to 96%, while documented process deviations double. What is the strongest operational interpretation?
choices: Performance unquestionably improved because completion is faster
The throughput metric improved, but quality worsened on another dimension; both trends need investigation before declaring overall improvement
The deviation metric should be ignored
On-time completion and deviations can never be compared
rationale: Operational performance is multidimensional. A gain in speed or completion can coexist with quality loss and should not be interpreted in isolation.
